wholePhysicalScope: The named multipolygon supplies the long narrow outer outline, twin tower blocks and two courtyard openings. The Generalitat recognizes the different towers at either end.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain both palace towers, the Gothic central range and its two courtyards.
limitations: The palace exterior, open courtyards and visible courtyard stair. Underground spaces and occupied interiors are outside scope.
Unpublished cornice, tower and balustrade dimensions are estimated.
